# Design House India

> Design House India (est. 1984) is a retail interior design, merchandising, and turnkey fit-out company based in India, providing design and execution services for retail interiors, corporate interiors, restaurants, kiosks, signage, exhibitions, office interiors, and modular furniture.

## Services
